routing.name: specjam-bounded-review
routing.description: Dispatches independent read-only reviewers and plans one synthesis writer.

workflow.action: Grant each reviewer read and search only
workflow.verify: Write and execute scope is refused
Failures and blocked results remain visible

decisions: degrade to a built-in reviewer when custom profiles are unsupported
safety_rules: never grant write or execute scope
rollback: retain the pre-review artifact if synthesis fails
